decisions.reason: It is an adjacent extension of the firm's established construction equipment range, remained prominently marketed in 2023 and 2024, and a growing industry gives little reason to withdraw it quickly.
As another close-to-core dumper model that kept its own product page across both years, it fits the firm's strategy of customer-specific machinery and is likely to stay in the portfolio.
This mine rescue vehicle is more distant from the core offer and its visibility fell from a dedicated page in 2023 to only a mention in 2024, which suggests weak traction for a niche product.
The compact telescopic loader builds directly on the firm's established lifting and construction capabilities and its continued standalone presentation indicates ongoing commercial commitment.
The material lift is close to the firm's core business and the reported large order plus long-standing rental popularity point to clear market acceptance.
Although more distant from the established range, the underground mining loader showed strong early field performance and was given a dedicated page, making continuation more likely than withdrawal.
